acceptance.meaning: Baseline evidence completeness, not parity accuracy or a requirement that every task succeeds.
acceptance.limits: Corpus receipts are operator-supplied provenance bound to observed target hashes, not authentication. Optional unscored profiles and absent Ghidra MCP comparison remain explicit limitations.

decompiler_health.limits: Type-truth entries and explicitly requested sorted-entry samples are timed. Returned C and no error do not establish correct recovery.

limits: Static gates are existing slice gates, not overall parity acceptance.
Unavailable or failed corpus selections are not successes; optional inventory is retained verbatim.
Type-recovery scores do not substitute for decompiler health or agent-task results.
Publication view omits detailed disagreements, model answers and transcripts; the private source report is hash-bound. Usage totals cover this run, not setup probes.
